_doc: Rotating coordinator schedule. The coordinator is the only chat allowed to merge phase branches to main. Rotates every 24h or on >2h idle. Verified by hooks/coordinator-only-mainmerge.mjs.

schedule._doc: Round-robin among the 6 stable session-id slots that are most frequently active. Filled in by helpers/coordinator-elect.mjs when 6 active chats are observed.

election_rule: Whoever's stable-session-id sorts first alphabetically among active chats becomes coordinator at midnight UTC. If that chat is idle >2h, next-in-sort takes over. Coordinator can voluntarily release via /coordinator-status --release.
